supplier_lifecycle_service.resolution_concentration_reduced: Concentration risk reduced by user action
supplier_lifecycle_service.concentration_issue_title: Risk concentration: {pct}% of critical processes depend on this supplier
supplier_lifecycle_service.concentration_issue_description: Supplier {supplier_name} concentrates {pct}% of the critical business processes that depend on it (DORA threshold: 40%). Possible actions: (1) distribute dependencies across alternative suppliers, (2) document the exit plan in the 'Exit strategy' field, (3) add new dependencies on other suppliers to reduce concentration, (4) add mitigation notes in the 'Concentration notes' field.
